facts.fact: StackAdapt was recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for 2026 with a rank of 15, according to the company's April 1, 2026 press release.
The Great Place To Work Canada 2026 study drew feedback from more than 600,000 employees nationwide, per the press release.
facts.quote: drawing on feedback from more than 600,000 employees nationwide

facts.fact: Over 900 companies competed for the Best Workplaces in Canada designation, according to a Great Place To Work Canada quote in the press release.
Great Place To Work states its Best Workplaces in Canada list is part of a global workplace study representing 11 million employees across more than 50 countries.
facts.quote: representing the voices of 11 million employees across more than 50 countries

facts.fact: StackAdapt's 2026 Best Workplaces in Canada results were published in The Globe and Mail's Report on Business section.
facts.quote: The results were published in [The Globe and Mail’s Report on Business section]
